resources.string: Welcome to UPM Mail
An independent email client for people aged 13 and older. Use a mailbox you are authorized to access and meet your provider\'s account requirements.

Use email respectfully. Do not send harassment, threats, hate, scams, spam, malware, illegal material, sexual exploitation or private information without permission. Do not send sexual content to minors. You can block senders locally and report abuse to your mail provider.

Blocking hides mail from this exact address and prevents communication with it in this app on this device. It does not block delivery at the mail server or in other apps. A sender can use a different address. You can undo this in Settings → Blocked senders.

Mail safety concern

Use the official abuse or safety address published by your mail provider. Enter that address and describe only what is necessary. No original messages, headers or attachments are included automatically. If your provider uses a web form, use its official website instead. The app developer does not operate a mail moderation service.
